fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects events in which a history file gets deleted, e.g. the ~/bash_history to remove traces of malicious activity
fields.name: History File Deletion
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "/rm" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/unlink" or tgt.process.image.path contains "/shred") and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "/.bash_history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "/.zsh_history") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "_history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains ".history" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "zhistory"))))
